analysis.summary: A review of fuzz testing for configuration-sensitive software -- systems whose reachable behaviour depends heavily on settings, so that testing at default configuration leaves much of the code unexercised.
analysis.narrative: Database systems appear in the review's opening enumeration of domains fuzzing has been applied to, with network protocols, hypervisors and autonomous vehicles. The mention is reachable only through the citation marker and carries no relationship beyond acknowledging the domain.
